profile.headline: Senior Software Developer
profile.summary:
Creating software to solve problems, including technical, business, and user experience concerns.

Specialties:
Programming Languages
JavaScript, ECMAScript 2015, TypeScript, C#, Go (Golang), Objective C, Java, Bash, PHP, Python, SQL

Tools & APIs
HTML5, Canvas, SVG, CSS, Angular 5, AngularJS, D3.js, node.js, Bootstrap, Material, Backbone + Marionette, jQuery, VS Code 1.3 - 1.25, WebStorm 4-10, WPF, Silverlight, Xaml, WP7, .NET 2.0/3.0/3.5/4.0/4.5, ASP.NET MVC, Microsoft Visual Studio 2002 - 2015/.NET/6, CocoaTouch, XCode 3.x - 8.x, nginx, Apache, SqlServer, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Git, Subversion, TFS, Vagrant, Bash, Sketch, Creative Suite/Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Expression Blend

Operating Systems
macOS (9, 10, Jaguar - Sierra), iOS (3.x - 10.x), Linux 2.2.x - 4.10.x (Debian, Ubuntu, Raspbian), Microsoft Windows (98, NT, XP - Win10), Windows Phone

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Producing, recreating, and/or updating small websites for various clients.  Duties included meeting with clients to discuss & whiteboard needs, creating and executing dev plans, and iterating based on feedback.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML5 · JavaScript · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · PHP · Ruby · Jekyll · C#

positions.title: Health and well-being
positions.description: Multiple changes to lifestyle and circumstances lead me to taking a long break as well as a relocation.

positions.title: Developer III
positions.description:
Consultant for Nortal and its clients.

Role Details
• Senior Front End Developer built a react spa deployed to AWS with SAM endpoints.
• Design and built many of the front-end components and containers
• Implemented endpoints in python, among other fullstack tasks
• Collaborated with and occasionally mentored team members
• Troubleshoot multiple environments as well as local development environment problems

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
Senior Developer for an internal team building mergers and acquisition enterprise software in Angular.

Role Details
• helped to design and build a new production-grade front-end application to ingest, manage and process specific kinds of personnel data and hierarchical relationships as well as run scenarios to measure merger progress and success factors.
• implemented several project-wide improvements to code-base, improved quality & tooling
• mentored junior developers with the goal of migrating away from jQuery code, covering topics related to Angular, VSTS and git, and provided updated toolchain with examples and boilerplate
• lobbied for multiple alterations to project lifecycle to increase productivity, eliminate unnecessary meetings and work

positions.title: Senior Specialist, Advisory
positions.description:
Consultant for KPMG and its clients.  I directly contributed to the successful completion of 18 projects, both short and long-running.

Role Details
• Senior Front End Developer helped to design and build new mobile-first and progressive web apps.
• Worked from existing code bases or new designs, helped to iterate designs with feedback, suggestions or technical limitations.
• Collaborated with team members to build out apps, components and/or extensions
• Produced high quality, tested code implementing business logic and rendering.
• Produced high fidelity styling, adhering to nuances in design comps.

positions.title: Senior User Experience Developer & Integrator
positions.description:
Consultant for various projects on behalf of Identitymine, Inc. and its clients.  Over the course of 4 years, I successfully helped conclude 20 WPF, Silverlight, Surface and WP7 projects, 9 of which are end user applications available for download.

• Integrated Styles, Control Templates, and other structured visual Resources into organized ResourceDictionaries for multiple applications built on WPF, Silverlight, WP7 and Surface.
• Designed animations, transitions and effects that compliment visual design comprehensives, and enhance the UI without subtracting from the overall end user experience.
• Implemented Custom Controls, Behaviors, View Models, and Design-Time Data to meet application requirements and improving productivity.
• Debugged and fixed both code and visual defects in software as well as solved deployment issues.

positions.title: Software Design Engineer Contract
positions.description:
Worked on the Avalon (WPF) Team building Applications and Demos utilizing WPF.

• Designed and developed core components of the New York Times TimesReader application.
• Collaborated with the WPF Flow team, WPF Program Managers and Testers to ensure the best and most performant use of WPF.
• Collaborated with New York Times designers to fine-tune many aspects of the look and feel.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Blue Ribbon Motoring is an online retailer of auto accessories and services. I designed and implemented several small desktop and service applications using C#, MSSQL, COM/Interop, and MS Office Objects to alleviate workflow problems associated with daily operations.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Consultant for various projects on behalf of SBI & Company (formerly Lante Corporation) and its clients. Software development technologies focused on both Microsoft .NET and Java.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Consultant on various projects on behalf of Luminant and its clients. Technologies focused on Server-Side unix systems and related technologies.

projects.title: WSD Operations and Marketing Software Revamp
New York Times Reader
projects.description: Design and development of version 1.0 of the New York Times reader, a WPF-based app for reading the New York Times on Windows tablets and PCs.
